newsitem.title: CANADA: Martin says Canada 96-97 deficit C$16 bln at most.
newsitem.headline: Martin says Canada 96-97 deficit C$16 bln at most.

text.p: Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin said on Thursday the federal budget deficit for 1996-97 would be C$16 billion at the most.

He repeated past calculations that the basic monthly figures for April 1996 through March 1997 came to C$9.6 billion, to which had to be added an end-of-year adjustment that he said in the past was in the range of C$4.5 billion to C$6 billion.
"That will give us a deficit that certainly will not be greater than C$16 billion and might be less," Martin told reporters.
